# dodopayments_discount (Data Source)

Reads one discount by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_discount" "example" {
  id = "<id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `amount` (Number) The discount amount in **basis points** (e.g., 540 => 5.4%).
- `business_id` (String) The business this discount belongs to.
- `code` (String) The discount code (up to 16 chars).
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the discount is created.
- `currency_options` (Attributes List) Per-currency options (flat deduction / percentage cap + minimum subtotal).
Empty for discounts without any configured currency options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currency_options))
- `customer_eligibility` (String) Who may redeem this discount code.
- `discount_id` (String) The unique discount ID.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional date/time after which discount is expired.
- `metadata` (String) Arbitrary key-value metadata. Values can be string, integer, number, or boolean. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `name` (String) Name for the Discount.
- `per_customer_usage_limit` (Number) Maximum number of times a single customer may redeem this discount, if any.
- `preserve_on_plan_change` (Boolean) Whether this discount should be preserved when a subscription changes plans.
Default: false (discount is removed on plan change).
- `restricted_to` (List of String) List of product IDs to which this discount is restricted.
- `starts_at` (String) Optional date/time before which the discount is not yet active. NULL = active immediately.
- `subscription_cycles` (Number) Number of subscription billing cycles this discount is valid for.
If not provided, the discount will be applied indefinitely to
all recurring payments related to the subscription.
- `times_used` (Number) How many times this discount has been used.
- `type` (String) The type of discount (`percentage` or `flat`).
- `usage_limit` (Number) Usage limit for this discount, if any.

<a id="nestedatt--currency_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `currency_options`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) The currency this option applies to.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default row FX conversions pivot from.
- `max_amount_possible` (Number) The most this code discounts in this currency's subunits (flat deduction
or percentage cap).
- `minimum_subtotal` (Number) Eligible-cart threshold in this currency's subunits (0 = no minimum).
